summary: American Electric Power Co Inc filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a $2.6B common stock offering under Rule 424(b)(5) and Registration No. 333-291275. The offering uses forward sale agreements with Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, and Morgan Stanley, where forward sellers borrow and sell shares to underwriters; proceeds to AEP are deferred until full physical settlement (expected on or prior to May 31, 2028). The last reported stock price was $130.70/share. This is a standard equity capital markets transaction to raise corporate funds, not a special situation. There are no tender, activist, merger, or restructuring features; it is routine financing.
